- `src/render.ts` — page/index HTML templates with HTML escaping
- `src/site.ts` — build pipeline: read `content/*.md`, write `<slug>.html` per page + `index.html` into output dir
- `src/cli.ts` — `ssg build [--content <dir>] [--output <dir>]` (bin → `dist/cli.js`, shebang preserved)
- `src/types.ts`, `src/index.ts` — shared types and public API
